The '''9PS''', also known as the '''"Gundark Fist" 9PS''', was a [[Scattergun/Legends|scattergun]] produced by [[Speizoc Arms]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Weighing 2.75 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] with a [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] of 400 millimeters and a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]-hide [[Stock/Legends|stock]] grip, the gun carried 50 [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] shells and had an effective range of 10 meters but a maximum range of 35 meters.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
